name: betterstack-ryno-monitoring-destructive
description: Irreversible or access-granting changes to the 'ryno' BetterStack tenant: delete monitors/dashboards/charts/webhooks/heartbeats/releases, remove catalog relations and records, change team member roles, invite or remove team members, and mint live ClickHouse data-access credentials. Several of these can silence alerting (remove_monitor, remove_heartbeat) or grant account access (change_team_member_role, create_cloud_connection).
